description: This file defines an abstract class 'Entry' within the 'Todaymade\Daux\Tree' namespace, representing a node in a documentation tree structure. It includes properties and methods for managing node attributes such as title, name, URI, parent, path, and URL, as well as methods for retrieving parent nodes and generating relative paths.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: An abstract class representing a node in a documentation tree, providing methods for managing node attributes and hierarchy.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Entry with parent directory, URI, and optional file info.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entry.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the entry.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the entry.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the URI of the entry and updates parent-child relationships.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the entry.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the entry.

methods.name: getNameForSort
methods.description: Provides a fallback string for sorting, based on name, title, or URI.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent directory of the entry.

methods.name: getParents
methods.description: Returns an array of all parent directories up to the root.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the full filesystem path of the entry.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Returns the path relative to the root of the documentation.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL for the entry.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns an array with the entry's properties for debugging.

methods.name: isHotPath
methods.description: Determines if the entry is on a hot path, delegating to its parent.
